summary: Fully verified the NEW Smart Bet player-props feature (backend + frontend) and the won/lost tips filter regression. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_smart_bets.py. GET /api/tips/counts returns {ai:36, ai_total:87, members:1, live:0, systems:4, smart:7}. GET /api/tips?source=smart&status=pending returns 7 tips all with source='smart', league='TipJarHQ Smart Bet', proper player-prop German markets (e.g. 'A. Llano — Über 0,5 Schüsse aufs Tor (1+)' @ 1.21, 'R. Sappinen — Torschütze (Anytime)' @ 2.42, 'G. Napa — Über 1,5 Paraden' @ 1.12, 'D. Díaz — Über 0,5 mal gefoult' @ 1.13), odds, ai_rating and German ai_analysis with Saison-Ø + Trefferwahrscheinlichkeit. GET /api/tips?source=members correctly EXCLUDES smart & hq-auto tips (0 leaks). GET /api/tips?status=won&source=ai returns exactly 3 settled hqtip-a-* WON tips. GET /api/tips?status=lost returns only status='lost' tips. Admin auth is enforced on /api/admin/smart/run and /api/admin/smart/reset (401/403 without token). Admin smart/run and smart/reset both succeed with proper token and return {posted, matches, candidates} and {deleted, posted, matches, candidates}. Frontend: view-smart-btn present on home with green background + count badge '7', clicking opens the tips-window on the Smart Bet view (title 'View Smart Bets') with tabview-smart selected and 7 tip-card-* rendering with the player-prop markets, German AI analysis, and Apex ratings. Won regression: opening tips-window on AI tab and clicking [data-testid='status-won'] shows 3 tip-card-* with 3 [data-testid='status-badge-won'] WON badges (Argentina vs Egypt final 3-2, Lincoln Red Imps vs Inter d'Escaldes final 3-1, Argentina vs Egypt Über 1.5). All acceptance criteria PASS.

critical_code_review_comments: list_tips source mapping (ai→hq-auto, smart→smart, members→$nin[hq-auto,smart]) works correctly — members feed cleanly excludes both smart and hq-auto tips as designed.
settle_pending_tips correctly excludes source=='smart' so player-prop tips are not auto-settled by the goals/score-based settler — good, since player props need per-player stats to settle.
smart_autopost / admin_smart_run / admin_smart_reset routes are registered before app.include_router, so they are reachable — verified via 200 responses with valid admin auth and 401 without.
Backend counts endpoint correctly includes 'smart' key alongside ai/ai_total/members/live/systems — no schema surprises for the frontend.
Frontend view-smart-btn uses grid-cols-5 layout (5 quick-view buttons) and the green highlight matches the AI Picks button visual language. UX consistent.
German copy in player-prop markets is well-formed: 'Über 0,5 Schüsse aufs Tor (1+)', 'Über 1,5 Paraden', 'Torschütze (Anytime)', 'Über 0,5 mal gefoult' — all read naturally for a German audience.

Minor observation (non-blocking): on the AI Picks tab, one of the 3 WON cards is 'Lincoln Red Imps vs Inter d'Escaldes' which is a repeat match with a different market — this is expected behaviour but if in future you want deduped 'match-level' cards on the Won tab, that would be an enhancement not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 acceptance criteria: view-smart-btn, smart cards render, won filter regression)

test_credentials: Admin admin@tipjar.com / TipJarAdmin2026! — used to obtain Bearer token for /api/admin/smart/run + /api/admin/smart/reset
seed_data_creation: None — did not create test tips. Called POST /api/admin/smart/reset which is a legitimate admin op that regenerates the smart tip set (deleted+reposted). Existing 7 smart tips + 3 settled won hq-auto tips were used as-is.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Smart Bet feature is live and healthy. If a future run finds counts.smart == 0, call POST /api/admin/smart/run as admin and re-check — smart tips depend on upcoming whitelist matches in match_predictions. The full backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_smart_bets.py covers counts, smart source filter, members-exclusion, won/lost, admin auth enforcement, and admin smart/run + smart/reset — run it with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_smart_bets.py -v -s`. Frontend testids to remember: view-smart-btn (home quickview), tabview-smart (tips-window tab), tip-card-* (tip cards), status-won (filter), status-badge-won (badge on won cards). To open tips-window reliably in playwright, dispatch window CustomEvent('tj-open-tips') — the direct button click sometimes fails when the promo banner overlays the header on first load.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Both the Smart Bet feature and the won/lost filter (previously-reported bug) are working end-to-end. The smart player-props tips render with correct German copy, correct source filtering (smart/members/ai), correct admin auth on the admin routes, and correct settlement exclusion (smart tips are not touched by settle_pending_tips).
